intro: Converting pounds (lb) to grams (g) is essential when translating measurements across international freight shipping, gym barbell loading, laboratory formulation, and commercial food packaging. One pound equals 453.59237 grams, while one gram equals 0.00220462 pounds. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many grams are in 1 pound?
faqs.answer: There are 453.59237 grams (g) in 1 pound (lb). To convert lb to g, use the exact conversion factor 453.59237.

faqs.question: How do I convert pounds to grams manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your pound value by 453.59237 (exact factor: 453.59237). For example, 10 lb × 453.59237 = 4,535.9237 g.
